messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: High 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Automated paging triggered for on-call team. Runbook: <https://redwood.runbooks/p1-api-5xx|p1-api-5xx>

alex_cheng: on it. digging into logs now. 5xx spike started ~10:05 PDT, concentrated on long-context models.

sara_nguyen: thanks alex. tagging for comms — we should draft a statuspage initial note and an internal summary for CS.

alex_cheng: quick checks: no obvious infra churn, queue depth slightly elevated on the batching service. currently throttling to protect backend.

mike_garcia: @alex_cheng can you confirm affected customer subset? I see elevated errors hitting two large customers and a batch ingestion job from an internal partner.

alex_cheng: confirmed: client-zen, atlas-ai, and an internal ingestion (ingest-batch-3). percentage of requests failing ~6% overall in the region, higher for >2048 token requests.

lee_support: tagging CS — I'll prepare customer-facing lines once we have a short summary. which customers should we proactively notify?

mike_garcia: client-zen and atlas-ai for sure. internal ingestion is on our side, ops team aware.

ops-bot: NOTE: Pager duty escalation bound to policy: if not acknowledged in 5 min escalate to SRE lead @sara_nguyen.

alex_cheng: creating a quick draft for the status page. paste below and we can refine: 

```
Initial update (we are investigating):
- Incident time: 2025-11-08T17:05:00Z
- Impact: Increased 5xx error rate for text generations in us-west-2; ~6% of requests overall, higher for very long-context requests.
- Customer impact: Some requests from select customers may return 5xx or time out; we are seeing impact on client-zen and atlas-ai.
- Mitigation in progress: throttling long requests to stabilize backend, rolling retry/backoff applied to affected services.
- Next update: in 20 minutes or sooner.
```

sara_nguyen: nit: avoid exact internal throttling details in public post. change "throttling long requests" -> "traffic controls applied to reduce error rate". and remove internal retry ops.

alex_cheng: updated draft below: 

```
Initial update (we are investigating):
- Incident time: 2025-11-08T17:05:00Z
- Impact: Increased 5xx error rate for text generation requests in the us-west-2 region; approximately 6% of requests overall, higher for very long-context requests.
- Customer impact: Some requests from select customers (including two customers) may see 5xx errors or timeouts.
- Mitigation: Traffic controls applied to stabilize the service; engineering investigation underway.
- Next update: within 20 minutes or sooner.
```

mike_garcia: that reads well. I'll post to statuspage once we get one ack from eng lead. @sara_nguyen can you sign off?

sara_nguyen: +1 to that wording. add a short internal summary for CS: what to say to clients if they ping.

lee_support: drafting CS blurb: 

"We are aware of increased errors impacting generation requests in the us-west-2 region. Our engineering team is investigating and applying traffic controls to reduce errors. We will provide an update in ~20 minutes. If you are seeing production impact, please reply here or open a dedicated support case and we will prioritize."

alex_cheng: looks good. small tweak: include ETA only if we have one — keep as "~20 minutes for next update" which is fine.

ops-bot: REMINDER: when posting to statuspage use the template tags: severity, customer_impact, mitigation, next_update.

mike_garcia: posting initial status update now to status.redwood.com. pinging client-zen and atlas-ai via dedicated channels after publish.

mike_garcia: (published) https://status.redwood.com/incident/usc-5xx-2025-11-08 — please review public copy below and flag any edits.

alex_cheng: saw it. public copy is good. two asks: 1) set next_update reminder at +20min; 2) add internal incident channel link for CS -> #incidents-client-zen (so CS can follow).

sara_nguyen: acknowledged. also preparing a short internal postmortem template and capturing timeline as we go.

lee_support: pinged both customers with the CS blurb and asked them to DM if they have urgent failures. client-zen replied they have a queued job failing; assigned to my channel with logs.

alex_cheng: mitigation progress: adjusted batching worker concurrency and rolled a config change to the routing layer — error rate dropped from 6% to ~2.2% within 8 minutes of the change. continuing to monitor.

mike_garcia: great. schedule: next public update due in ~10 minutes. if error rate stays below 1% we should prepare resolved draft.

sara_nguyen: can someone capture short timeline entries? I'll start: 
- 17:05 UTC: alert raised by monitoring (5xx spike).
- 17:07 UTC: page routed to on-call (alex_cheng).

alex_cheng: adding: 
- 17:12 UTC: traffic controls applied; batching worker concurrency adjusted.
- 17:20 UTC: observed error rate drop to ~2.2%.

ops-bot: METRIC: 5xx_rate us-west-2: 6.0% -> 2.2% (17:20) -> 0.8% (17:38).

alex_cheng: follow-up: continuing to monitor to ensure stability for 30m. recommended timeline for status updates: initial -> +20m -> +40m -> resolved.

mike_garcia: preparing resolved copy in case we hit stable state: 

```
Resolved:
- Incident time: 2025-11-08T17:05:00Z
- Summary: A transient increase in 5xx errors for text generation in us-west-2 impacted a subset of customers. Engineering applied traffic controls and configuration changes which mitigated the issue.
- Impact: Some requests for long-context generations returned 5xx or timed out. Mitigation reduced the error rate to below service SLOs; there is no ongoing customer impact.
- Follow-up: Post-incident review scheduled; any impacted customers will be contacted by CS.
```

lee_support: +1. I'll follow up with the two customers to ensure they have no remaining issues and offer a dedicated bridge if needed.

sara_nguyen: good. I'm assigning the postmortem owner to @alex_cheng and CCing @mike_garcia for CS notes.

alex_cheng: assigned. capturing a list of action items: investigate long-context path for failure modes, add better traffic shaping docs, evaluate batching thresholds.

mike_garcia: publishing +resolved in 30 minutes if metrics stable. thanks all for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE (resolved target): please confirm final metric window before posting resolved. automated snapshot will be attached to the incident ticket.

alex_cheng: will post final metrics and close when stable for 15m.

lee_support: closing customer threads as resolved unless they reopen.

mike_garcia: closing internal comms — good job team.
